h: Moshe Gives Israel the Power to See Torah

p: רְאֵה אָנֹכִי נוֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם (דְּבָרִים יא, כו)
"See, I set before you this day" (Devarim 11:26).
It opens with "see" in the singular,
the Ten Commandments, which opened with "Anochi."
And afterward the Baal HaTurim says:
the final letters of the words spell "Torah";
But this is not in order.
The matter is according to what is written
"He made the letter Reish king, etc.,
and the sixth day in the year, etc.;
He made the letter Tav king, etc.,
and the day of Shabbos in the year."
is a semblance of the World to Come,
one sixtieth of the World to Come,
and the letter Tav alludes to the World to Come
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר רַבֵּינוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ
based on what our holy Rebbe,
of blessed memory, of Izhbitz said,
that the last of the letters of this world
while Tav belongs to the World to Come);
therefore Shabbos was created with it.
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus
we call it the Oral Torah" (Tikkunei Zohar 17a)
is from the dew of Atika,
that was hidden away for those who toil in the Oral Torah
(as is written in Tanchuma, Parshas Noach 3).
And it is as they said (in Pesach Eliyahu, Tikkunei Zohar 17b):
"The Supernal Crown, which is the Crown of Malchus."
And the preparation for this is the sixth day,
which corresponds to the attribute of Tzaddik, Foundation of the World;
and on it Adam HaRishon was created,
who is the Tzaddik, Foundation of the World.
From the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
the flow of bounty follows the order of T-O-R-A-H;
which is the attribute of Malchus,
עַל יְדֵי ו׳ מִדַּת צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם
through the Vav, the attribute of Tzaddik, Foundation of the World,
created with the letter Reish, as mentioned above.
And it is the middle bar
that runs from end to end,
from the Supernal Crown, which is the Tav,
from the side of man's endeavor;
then the order is like the final letters
הַיְינוּ שֶׁזּוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי ה׳ תַּתָּאָה
That is, one merits through the lower Hei,
which is the aspect of fear,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א ה, ב)
the light of the Oral Torah,
which is from the dew of Atika,
to which the letter Tav alludes,
for it is of the World to Come,
the day that is entirely Shabbos;
and this is alluded to by the final letters
that is, that the fear enters the heart,
for this is what the word "hearing" indicates,
that it should enter the heart;
"Above all that you guard, keep your heart,
for out of it are the issues of life."
And this one merits from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
to which the letter Vav alludes,
the aspect of the Holy One, blessed be He,
which is the attribute of Tzaddik,
with which the sixth day was created;
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.
And this is what it says: "See, I"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנו, ב)
and only the individual merits to see this,
and this is "see" in the singular;
for the words of Torah were given to all of Yisrael.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אַחַר כָּךְ (דְּבָרִים יא, כז)
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (דְּבָרִים לג, ד)
It is in the manner of what is said (Devarim 33:4):
an inheritance of the congregation of Yaakov."
so that they merit to see the words of Torah
and they, by their power of sight,
bring the words of Torah into all of Yisrael
(as explained in Parshas Masei and elsewhere).
the power of sight I give you,
to bring the light "that it was good"

paragraphs.text: Source: Berachos 57b — “חמשה וששה ועשרה סימן: חמשה אחד מששים, אלו הן: אש, דבש, ושבת, ושינה, וחלום. אש — אחד מששים לגיהנם. דבש — אחד מששים למן. שבת — אחד מששים לעולם הבא. …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 146) — “The numbers five, six, and ten are mnemonics for the categories to follow. The Gemara says: There are five matters in our world which are one-sixtieth of their most extreme manifestations. They are: Fire, honey, Shabbat, sleep, and a dream. …”
